scientific_question: Does deterministic WavLM weighted-sum training remain representation-limited, or was the epoch-15 fixed futility threshold too early for its delayed ArcFace learning curve?

control_curve_evidence.interpretation: The previous 0.88-at-epoch15 futility rule would have rejected the eventual CAM++ control winner and is therefore invalid as a generic convergence gate.

activation_gate.failing_action: Skip P13c and activate the separately preregistered P14 L-adapter probe.

locked_change.single_scientific_change: Continue the exact P13b Raw model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG and history from completed epoch 15; replace the invalid fixed futility gate with plateau-based early stopping.
locked_change.ema_resume_policy: EMA is diagnostic only and restarts from resumed Raw weights because the pipeline checkpoint does not persist an EMA shadow.

selection.checkpoint: best completed Raw probability-average Macro-F1 across the contiguous epoch-1-to-terminal history

fold0_gate.passing_action: Permit complementary error analysis only; no automatic later fold or submission.
fold0_gate.failing_action: Close weighted-sum WavLM and activate P14 L-adapter.

immediate_stop: split, class-map, resume-contract, optimizer, scheduler, RNG or history mismatch
